notes: Re-extraction reading all pages. Governmental activities are modified cash basis, business-type activities accrual; basis recorded as cash. Governmental beginning 1,134,796 and ending 1,180,151 are total governmental fund balances (all cash, CDs and county treasurer cash, p4/p5). Governmental statement uses Total Governmental Funds column (p5); transfers in 123,358 are in transfers_in. Business-type lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p8) Totals column; transfers net (123,358) out; net position 7,726,589 to 7,788,660 reconciles. Business-type spending listed by object so function set to utilities with review (detail lines use function by fund: Community Center culture/recreation, Nursing Home health/welfare). Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1); p6 proprietary total assets 11,393,274 includes 50,516 due from other fund eliminated on p1 (11,342,758); p7 proprietary total liabilities 3,604,614 vs p1 3,554,098 (same 50,516 interfund). Cash flow statement (pp9-10) not recorded in proprietary (modified cash city, not GAAP). Detail: General Fund detail uses the combining schedule p22 (receipts by column, capital outlay) and p24 (disbursements by object per column) in place of the less detailed General Fund budget schedule p11 (budget amounts not carried; p11 budget total receipts 743,021, disbursements 1,543,220). General Fund transfers use total-column gross lines on p23 (in 404,000, out 342,592, net 61,408, vs 123,358 total transfers in on p5 which includes Streets 61,950). Department functions on p24 follow p22 function totals (Police 2,269 general government + 428,500 public safety; Library and Swimming Pool general government except pool Community Improvement 8,906 culture). General column miscellaneous 246,553 split into sale of assets 237,905 and 8,648 miscellaneous (assumed sale sits in General column). Streets, Keno and each business-type fund (Water, Sewer, Electric, Community Center, Nursing Home, Landfill, Gas/Pace) recorded from their budgetary comparison schedules (actual and original/final budget); business-type revenue/expenditure totals computed as operating plus non-operating (interest) lines; transfers recorded as other financing. Dashes printed as 0. Community Development Agency Fund recorded from its budgetary comparison schedule (p20, gained in the v7 re-trim: property tax 77,201, debt principal 56,192, interest 27,074; total disbursements 83,266; the debt service lines are the same as the p5 governmental debt service lines). Other nonmajor governmental funds have no schedule. Read pages 1-24 of 24.
